context:
# Goal
Round 56, kama local model serving and endpoint health. One v2 wave, 64 seats, build and attack together. L1 is the frozen-topology planner seat; no planner role is added to this validated wave.

## Frozen claims (before data)
C1 — operability 8->8. At a live child with `LD_AUDIT=/usr/lib/libexpat.so.1`, `tools/round56-env-leg-test.py` calls the selected counter's `env_leg`: the round-55 counter is the red baseline (`ld_audit=missed`, exit 0), the round-56 counter detects the variable (`ld_audit=detected`, exit 0), and a one-line mutant deleting LD_AUDIT from BAD_ENV misses it so the battery's expected-detected assertion fails. Predicate, targets, kill rule and counter hash are frozen in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-56/preregistration.json. Frozen counter `tools/round56-replay-code-audit.py` sha256 fc3d4b63a3020cf37e6f4080e25c9d693a8b177c4f84cae6688b2e445444ff6f.
C2 — calibration 7->7. `tools/round56-prereg-check.py` parses the committed battery ROSTER and compares it exactly with the preregistered roster; base at e10b6d39af450e8d652be9ac2986768b531fe13f: present=0, met=False; freeze efc6b3ec6fb6ea308c15855e9b8b62856f4255b7: present=1 roster_match=1 kills=1 controls=2 met=True. Predicate and kill rule in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-56/preregistration.json. Frozen checker sha256 c7b0d787f348691bbc057114b455545f5abfb0c70ec497e1ad695591f1489853.

## Shared read-only surfaces and write bounds
- Lane tree /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin is READ-ONLY for seats except each seat's unique output directory /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-56/w1/out/<SeatName>/; no shared production edits. Fleet root /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin, sibling lanes, and /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokuknow are READ-ONLY. Never mutate lane jj state/index; never run git add/commit/reset in the lane.
- Every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin; write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/<that path>. Any other deliverable belongs only in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-56/w1/out/<SeatName>/.
- Per-seat scratch is `/fast/scratch/hyaku/kama-r56/<SeatName>/`; create it, set TMPDIR explicitly, use at most one shared clone, copy needed receipts into your output directory, and remove scratch before yielding. Never use /tmp for evidence or large scratch.
- Tooling authorization: any agent may install/upgrade useful tools; first read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md, use official channels, and report tool/version/channel/reason. Pacman transactions are PAUSED host-wide: never invoke pacman; use uv/npx/official binary or file an L0 question. Do not change route config.
- The L1 already ran the base controls and committed the freeze. Seats are advisory, never judges. Do not change claim predicates, counters, target, kill rule or preregistration after scoring starts. Report exact command/output/exit and any defect with a proposed fix; never claim unrun checks passed.
